_comment: Sponsored affiliate offers (AdPrecise / Everflow) for guides. tools/write_articles.py writes one guide on an offer's `topic` on its `date` (or with --offer KEY) and adds the offer as a pick card marked Sponsored. {slug} in url = the guide's slug. Set active false to stop an offer.

offers.name: Cozy Cove Pro Portable Heater
offers.topic: small plug-in space heaters for one chilly room (safety shut-offs, tip-over protection, wattage and running cost, where not to put one)
offers.blurb: A lightweight plug-in heater with a remote and an adjustable thermostat, meant for warming one room rather than a whole house. The seller describes it as quiet and needing no installation.

offers.name: Amplihear Rechargeable Hearing Aids
offers.topic: low-cost rechargeable over-the-counter hearing aids (who OTC aids suit, what the FDA category covers, fit, return windows, when to see an audiologist)
offers.blurb: Small in-ear hearing aids with a wireless charging case; the seller lists more than 64 hours of battery life and says no hearing test is required. As with any over-the-counter aid, they are meant for mild to moderate hearing loss.

offers.name: RoadBoost 4-in-1 Roadside Emergency Kit
offers.topic: winter car emergency gear: portable jump starters and tire inflators (how they work, what to keep charged, what to keep in the trunk)
offers.blurb: One compact unit that jump-starts a dead battery without a second car, inflates a low tire to a PSI you set and then stops by itself, and doubles as an emergency light and phone charger.

offers.name: OxiPulse Pro Fingertip Pulse Oximeter
offers.topic: fingertip pulse oximeters for home use (how to take a reading, what affects accuracy, FDA guidance on over-the-counter oximeters, when to call a doctor)
offers.blurb: A one-button fingertip monitor that shows oxygen saturation and heart rate on a large display. It is a home wellness check, not a substitute for a doctor's reading.

offers.name: Solana Gear Heated Vest
offers.topic: heated vests and jackets as a gift for someone who is always cold (battery packs, heat zones, washing, sizing, who should check with a doctor first)
offers.blurb: A battery-heated vest the seller says gives up to 8 hours of warmth and is machine washable. A practical gift for someone who feels the cold on walks or in a drafty house.

offers.name: Power Scour Cordless Power Scrubber
offers.topic: cordless electric spin scrubbers for tubs, tile and sinks when scrubbing is hard on the wrists and back (handle length, brush heads, battery life, water resistance)
offers.blurb: A cordless, rechargeable scrubber with interchangeable brush heads that does the scrubbing motion for you, which helps if gripping and pressing is hard on your hands.

offers.name: RevivaFlow Foot Massager
offers.topic: at-home foot massagers and heated wraps for tired, achy feet (types, heat and compression, who should ask a doctor first such as people with diabetes, neuropathy or a pacemaker)
offers.blurb: A strap-on foot device that combines gentle electrical stimulation, heat and adjustable compression in 20-minute sessions. People with diabetes, a pacemaker or circulation problems should ask their doctor before using one.

offers.name: Car-Vue 1080P Dash Cam
offers.topic: simple dash cams for everyday drivers (why have one, loop recording, memory cards, mounting, state rules on windshield mounts and audio recording)
offers.blurb: A 1080P dash camera with a wide-angle lens, loop recording and motion detection, so there is a record if something happens on the road or in a parking lot.
